svg.title: Two court descriptions of the same 33,000-acre Bohemia Spillway
svg.desc: 1986 original opinion: approximately 48 percent purchased and 52 percent transferred from the state; a separate footnote says less than 3 percent expropriated, not an additional share. October 1986 rehearing: 3 percent expropriated, 48 percent purchased, and 49 percent public transfer. An August 1988 federal appeals opinion summarizes approximately 51 percent private acquisition and the remainder public. These are approximate judicial descriptions, not an independent survey.
svg.metadata: Original evidence graphic: Final Vestige Studios; 2026-11-15. © Final Vestige Studios. Sources: Louisiana Supreme Court, 483 So.2d 958 (February 24, 1986, rehearing granted May 15), https://law.justia.com/cases/louisiana/supreme-court/1986/85-ca-1448-4.html ; Louisiana Supreme Court, 496 So.2d 281 (October 20, 1986), https://law.justia.com/cases/louisiana/supreme-court/1986/85-ca-1448-3.html ; US Court of Appeals Fifth Circuit, Board of Levee Commissioners v Huls, 852 F.2d 140 (August 15, 1988), https://law.resource.org/pub/us/case/reporter/F2/852/852.F2d.140.87-3755.html . No external assets; diagram based on published judicial texts, underlying 1984 URS survey not independently obtained. Not historical imagery.
